stem: Which quotation from the article shows that the area that became Venice was a good place to take refuge from invaders?

options.label: A
options.text: Instead of car-filled streets, the city of Venice in Italy has a system of winding canals. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: The islands had long been used by fishermen but were inhospitable and mostly uninhabited. (paragraph 3)

options.label: C
options.text: Although many of the refugees eventually returned to the mainland, some people remained on the islands. (paragraph 4)

options.label: D
options.text: Even so, Venice's natural-turned-urban setting has special challenges. (paragraph 11)
